purpose: Teach: 楓/出逢い/隠れ家/どんぐり/硬貨/大砲/散髪/ブルーベリー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと楓の紅葉を見に行ったぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, we went to see the maple leaves turn in autumn.
lines.style: Soft, remembering tone. Each phrase lands gently, like a hand opening to show something precious. Quiet pace, no rush. Eyes focused on something far away and long ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、私との出逢いを語ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, that's right, dear — he used to tell us about the day we first met.
lines.style: Warm affirmation, gently correcting the record. Soft, intimate voice as if sharing a secret with him alone. Slight rise at the end—checking he remembers the same way.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは山小屋を隠れ家とされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father used the mountain cabin as his private retreat.
lines.style: Quieter now, more reverent. Slow unfolding of a detail. Slight pause before 'retreat,' honoring the privacy of that memory. Voice settles deeper.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、秋にどんぐりを集めて下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, and in autumn he'd collect acorns for us, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Fondness rises in the voice. Small, warm laugh threaded through. Affirming—she's seeing it too. A slight lilt on 'acorns,' like she can almost feel them in her hand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが古い硬貨を集めていらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father collected old coins—such interesting pieces they were.
lines.style: Appreciative and specific. Slight pride in the detail. Voice slow and even, like he's turning each coin over in his mind. Trailing off on 'pieces,' letting her imagine them.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様と大砲の歴史のお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he told our grandson all about the history of cannons, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Pleased recollection. Voice lifts slightly—pride in his generosity to the grandchild. Warm and intimate, speaking as if sharing with him alone. Small, knowing smile underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは月一回散髪に通われたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father went for a haircut every month, regular as clockwork.
lines.style: Gentle specificity. Voice finds a rhythm in the repetition. Small smile underneath—appreciating his quiet orderliness. Settles the detail like tucking a blanket.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お庭でブルーベリーを育てていらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he grew blueberries in the garden for us, didn't he, dear? Such a careful man.
lines.style: Warm and close, like whispering to him in the dark. Voice softens further than before. Slight breathiness on the last phrase. Hand reaches out to touch his arm, almost.
